synthesis.climate_context: Shared Melbourne-metro temperate climate — rain, mud and grit tracked into high-traffic entrances, foyers and washrooms; general Melbourne context, not a suburb-specific measured claim.

[source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hawthorn,_Victoria]

commercial_anchors.commercial_summary: Hawthorn (City of Boroondara, postcode 3122) is an inner-eastern suburb 6 km east of the CBD whose commercial life is concentrated on named strips rather than business parks. Glenferrie Road is the major shopping strip (two supermarkets, major banks, chain and specialty stores) and sits within the Glenferrie civic precinct; further retail runs along Auburn Road, Church Street, and the Burwood Road corridor, which the council's Glenferrie Structure Plan and West Hawthorn Urban Design Framework treat as retail and commercial land. The suburb's largest single demand generator is Swinburne University of Technology's Hawthorn campus, supported by Glenferrie Private Hospital, the Hawthorn Arts Centre and Boroondara council offices in the former Hawthorn Town Hall, a dense cluster of private and state schools including Scotch College, a restaurant, hotel and nightclub scene, and a pocket of light industry on Burwood Road between Power Street and Auburn Road.
